channel.title: PhotonDispatch
channel.description: Independent, answer-first quantum computing and quantum technology news: hardware, algorithms, industry and funding, research and policy.

item.title: Diraq switches on an eight qubit silicon spin quantum computer inside Equinix Sydney
item.description: Diraq says its silicon spin system is live in a commercial data centre, draws under 20 kW and is targeted to reach 256 qubits within a year.

item.title: Quantum Computing Inc posts $9.5 million quarterly revenue as acquisitions kick in
item.description: QCi's third quarter revenue beat its whole first half total, driven by acquired photonics and packaging businesses. It lost $15.1 million and holds about $1.3 billion.

item.title: Abu Dhabi Maritime Academy partners with Quincus and Quantinuum on quantum research
item.description: ADMA, Quincus and Quantinuum will study quantum, AI and high-performance computing for maritime operations, logistics and mining. No operational quantum advantage is claimed.

item.title: IBM patent filing describes sharing quantum processors by reusing noise models
item.description: IBM's "Quantum Queue Optimization for Error Mitigation" application describes a scheduler that groups compatible jobs on one chip and reuses stored noise models to cut repeated error-mitigation work.

item.title: Oxford trapped-ion experiment shows Aharonov-Bohm interference in a lattice gauge theory loop
item.description: Using two strontium ions, Oxford researchers simulated a Z2 lattice gauge theory loop in which zero flux doubled a particle's tunneling and a vison flux froze it, according to a Nature Physics study.

item.title: UK FCA launches regulator-led quantum experimentation group to tackle financial crime
item.description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority will launch a Quantum Experimentation Group in Q1 2027 to test whether quantum machine learning can help detect money laundering and fraud, using an FCA synthetic dataset. Registration closes 31 December 2026.

item.title: D-Wave wins Digital Innovation Award for Italy's first annealing quantum computer
item.description: D-Wave said it won a 2026 Digital Innovation Award in the Quantum Computing and High-Performance Computing category for its project to deploy an Advantage2 annealing quantum computer in Italy with Swiss Quantum Technology and the Q-Alliance.

item.title: UK's National Quantum Computing Centre signs Phasecraft software licence for SparQ users
item.description: The UK National Quantum Computing Centre has signed an enterprise licence with Phasecraft, giving UK businesses, researchers and public sector users access to its Magritte, Monet and Mondrian quantum software. Applications open in late November 2026.

item.title: IBM unveils Quantum System Two in Chicago at Hyde Park Labs
item.description: IBM, the University of Chicago, Illinois and IQMP unveiled an IBM Quantum System Two in Chicago—IBM’s first quantum computer in Illinois—powered by Quantum Nighthawk at Hyde Park Labs.

item.title: DeepMind says AI agents uncovered two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
item.description: Google DeepMind said on 6 November 2026 that human-guided AI agents uncovered two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA cryptosystems, while stressing that modern 2048-bit systems remain safe from those specific exploits.

item.title: IonQ CEO DeMasi tells Barron’s the firm is building a Western quantum ecosystem and cites DARPA’s final stage
item.description: IonQ posted a Barron’s interview quote from CEO Niccolo DeMasi about building a quantum ecosystem for the United States, Five Eyes, and NATO, and said the company has advanced to the final stage of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative.

item.title: PSI says its system found a Lean-checked proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
item.description: Physical Superintelligence PBC said on 6 November 2026 that an internal research system using a non-public Anthropic model produced a Lean-accepted proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture. The claim is the company's announcement; independent peer review may still be pending.

item.title: Quantinuum maps Nexus developer platform path towards fault tolerant computing
item.description: Quantinuum has outlined a multi generation Nexus roadmap designed to connect application development with successive quantum hardware systems, including Apollo, which it plans for 2029.

item.title: IonQ posts record Q3 revenue of $173.8 million and raises 2026 guidance to $505 to $515 million
item.description: IonQ reported GAAP revenue of $173.8 million for Q3 2026, up 336% year over year, raised full year revenue guidance to $505 to $515 million, and said remaining performance obligations reached $1.2 billion.

item.title: ORNL, IBM and AMD Launch Co-Design Platform for Quantum Error Correction
item.description: IBM, Oak Ridge’s Quantum Science Center and AMD unveiled a co-design platform on 5 Nov 2026 pairing IBM’s 120-qubit Nighthawk with ORNL’s Umbra HPC system (AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs and 5th Gen EPYC CPUs) for quantum error-correction research aimed at DOE’s 2028 goals.

item.title: NASA Glenn Says Researchers Sent Photons Air-to-Ground Over a Quantum Channel in the US
item.description: NASA Glenn Research Center posted on 4 Nov 2026 that researchers sent photons between an aircraft and a ground station over a quantum channel, calling it a US first; a 22 Oct LinkedIn post by Carolyn Mercer described witnessing an air-to-ground quantum entanglement demonstration at Glenn. No nasa.gov press release for this claim was found.

item.title: IonQ Partners with QuantumCT for 150+ Hours of Trapped-Ion Cloud Access in Connecticut
item.description: IonQ announced a partnership with QuantumCT on 4 Nov 2026 that provides more than 150 hours of cloud runtime on IonQ trapped-ion systems for Connecticut universities, labs, startups and enterprises.

item.title: IonQ Completes $1.15 Billion All-Stock Acquisition of Elisity
item.description: IonQ has closed its all-stock purchase of Zero Trust security company Elisity, issuing $1.15 billion in common stock, with up to $150 million more tied to revenue milestones.

item.title: IQM Emerald Entangles All 54 Qubits, Opening Full Processor to Cloud Users
item.description: IQM Quantum Computers says its Emerald quantum processor has achieved simultaneous entanglement across all 54 qubits, marking a step toward using the entire...

item.title: Harvest now, decrypt later: why encrypted data is already at risk from quantum computers
item.description: Harvest now, decrypt later means recording encrypted traffic today and breaking it once a large quantum computer exists. Here is how the threat works and why it sets the migration clock.

item.title: Alice & Bob says 22,593 cat qubits could factor RSA-2048 in 3.14 days, in a new estimate
item.description: Alice & Bob's new preprint estimates that a fault-tolerant machine built from its cat qubits could factor RSA-2048 with 22,593 physical qubits in 3.14 days. It is a resource estimate on paper, not a demonstration, and it assumes hardware no one has built yet.

item.title: Universal Quantum Unveils Integrated Ion-Trap Processor for DLR Systems
item.description: Universal Quantum says its new iQPU integrates a large trapped-ion surface, custom control electronics and modular links for two German Aerospace Center systems.

item.title: Quint Computing Raises €9.1 Million for Error-Suppressing Quantum Chips
item.description: German startup Quint Computing has raised €9.1 million in a first funding round and secured a separate €2.2 million European research grant for its quantum hardware approach.

item.title: Alice & Bob Reports Multi-Hour Bit-Flip Lifetimes on Cat-Qubit Hardware
item.description: Alice & Bob has reported 44-minute average bit-flip lifetimes on a single device and multi-hour measurements on its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor, with major gate-level challenges remaining.

item.title: What is FN-DSA? NIST's Falcon signature standard, and why FIPS 206 isn't published yet
item.description: Checked on csrc.nist.gov on 2 November 2026, FIPS 206 for FN-DSA, NIST's planned Falcon-based signature standard, still has no public draft.

item.title: What is HQC? NIST's backup to ML-KEM, explained
item.description: According to NIST, HQC is a code-based encryption algorithm chosen in March 2025 as a backup to ML-KEM, with a final standard expected in 2027.

item.title: Quantum error correction basics: syndromes, thresholds and why overhead matters
item.description: Quantum error correction detects errors through parity-check measurements and, below a hardware threshold, makes encoded qubits more reliable as codes grow, according to the research literature.

item.title: What is a logical qubit, and why do quantum computers need them?
item.description: A logical qubit is one unit of quantum information spread across many physical qubits so that errors can be detected and corrected, as described in surface-code research.

item.title: What ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA each do in NIST's post-quantum standards
item.description: According to NIST, FIPS 203, 204 and 205, effective 14 August 2024, cover key establishment (ML-KEM) and two signature methods (ML-DSA and SLH-DSA).

item.title: IQM says Emerald entangled all 54 qubits, with a GHZ fidelity of 0.516
item.description: IQM says its Emerald cloud system prepared a 54-qubit GHZ state at fidelity 0.516 with readout-error mitigation, just above 0.5.

item.title: NIST says quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms are deprecated after 2030 and disallowed after 2035
item.description: According to NIST IR 8547, published 27 October 2026, quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms are deprecated after 2030 and disallowed after 2035.

item.title: Iceberg Quantum cuts its RSA-2048 factoring estimate to about 48,000 qubits in simulations
item.description: Iceberg Quantum's Pinnacle 1.2 says simulations show RSA-2048 factoring could need about 48,000 physical qubits and roughly a day under its best assumptions.

item.title: Quantinuum says Helios hit 99.9995% logical fidelity, a tenfold error-correction record
item.description: Quantinuum says its Helios trapped-ion computer reached 99.9995% logical fidelity with a color code, about five errors per million operations.

item.title: Google shows magic state cultivation on Willow, cutting errors about 40x
item.description: Google Quantum AI says magic state cultivation worked on its Willow chip, cutting errors about 40-fold and yielding T-states at 99.99% logical fidelity.

item.title: Qilimanjaro raises €19.6 million Series A first close led by Indra Group
item.description: Barcelona's Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech says it closed €19.6 million, with €10 million from Indra Group via IndraMind and €9.6 million from Spain's SETT.

item.title: UK puts £78 million into quantum sensing, networking and apprenticeships
item.description: The UK government announced £78 million for quantum: £50 million for sensing and navigation projects, £20 million for networking and £8 million for apprentices.
